service.description: getShopContext (impl-shop P1): the published site, its Shop mount, the store the mount targets, the locale, currency, active theme release (the mount's PublicThemeBinding, null when none) and capabilities. A site not published, a missing or disabled Shop mount and a store gone or not an internal organization's are all NotFound (NOT_AVAILABLE).
getShopHome: the store's featured products and its top categories. Every answer carries the site's generation and active releaseId (impl-shop P3; ShopCatalog.js).
getStoreCategories: the store's browse tree, each category with a published product in it or below it. Every answer carries the site's generation and active releaseId (impl-shop P3; ShopCatalog.js).

getStoreCategory: a category of the store's tree (NotFound otherwise), its subcategories and a page of its public products (input productCategoryId, sort, cursor, limit). Every answer carries the site's generation and active releaseId (impl-shop P3; ShopCatalog.js).

findProducts: a page of the store's public products, of a category and by name when given (input productCategoryId, query, sort, cursor, limit). Every answer carries the site's generation and active releaseId (impl-shop P3; ShopCatalog.js).

searchShop: the public products whose index document (MantleProduct, a candidate source only) or name matches input.query, and the site's live Shop pages by title; state results, noMatch or unavailable. Every answer carries the site's generation and active releaseId (impl-shop P3; ShopCatalog.js).

getProduct: a product public in the store (NotFound otherwise): its card, description, public variants and the quote of input.variantId and input.quantity. Every answer carries the site's generation and active releaseId (impl-shop P3; ShopCatalog.js).
quoteSelection: the price of a product's variant and quantity with its availability; nothing is added. Every answer carries the site's generation and active releaseId (impl-shop P3; ShopCatalog.js).

getStorePage: the site's page of the Shop mount live at input.routePath, its exact published version (Commerce P4's get#SitePage by mount, route and locale). Every answer carries the site's generation and active releaseId (impl-shop P3; ShopCatalog.js).

getShopSitemap: the site paths of the store's current public pages (home, categories, products, Shop pages). Every answer carries the site's generation and active releaseId (impl-shop P3; ShopCatalog.js).

getShopProductImage: an image (PcntImage* content of a png, jpeg, gif or webp file, in effect for the store) of a product public in the store now, by input.productContentId: result.file (mimeType, filename) and result.location, which the frontend or the authority's transport streams; anything else is NotFound (NOT_AVAILABLE).

getProductReviews: the approved reviews of a product public in the store (NotFound otherwise), newest first a page at a time (input.cursor, input.limit up to 20), each with its rating, text, the author's chosen label (never an account, party or email), date, verified purchase, the store's reply and its images by digest; the summary of the approved reviews only; the signed-in author's own review in any state; whether the visitor can write one.

submitProductReview: a signed-in account's review (its email verified; Shop P6's claim first) of a product public in the store, proven by its own delivered order line of it, found here (PURCHASE_REQUIRED without one); rating 1 to 5, plain text, the display choice (name or anonymous), pending until approved. With productReviewId and expectedRevision, the author's edit, which returns an approved review to pending; a second new review of the product is ALREADY_REVIEWED. input.file adds one PNG or JPEG photo (up to three), staged and scanned: one refused is named in imageRefused and the text kept; removeImageSeqIds removes the author's photos.

getShopReviewImage: a review's image by its digest (input.reviewImage) while the review is approved and its product public in the store now: result.file (mimeType, filename) and result.location, which the frontend or the authority's transport streams; anything else is NotFound (NOT_AVAILABLE).
